persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrījaya bhūpatīndramalladeva prabhu thākulasana kavaśiyā cosasāṃ jhyāla pratiṣṭhā yāyayātā thva saṃphuli dayakase bijyāṅā dina juro

date.as_written: samvat 828 māghamāse kṛṣṇapakṣa caturddaśyāṃ tithau śravaṇanakṣetre parighayoge somavāsare

purpose: kavaśiyā cosasāṃ jhyāla pratiṣṭhā yāyayātā (for the consecration of a window)
notes: The manuscript was ordered by King Bhūpatīndra Malla of Bhaktapur on the occasion of the consecration of a window (kavaśiyā cosasāṃ jhyāla pratiṣṭhā). The scribe is not named, though a standard scribal excuse stanza is included.
